name: Knowt
summary: AI study platform with flashcards, lecture summaries, practice tests and AP exam prep.
description: Knowt offers AI study tools: flashcards with learn mode, lecture recording and summarisation into notes, and practice modes. Begin on Basic for free; Ultra and Max are paid tiers.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: 7.23 €/mo (Ultra, billed annually; 86.85 € billed upfront). Ultra monthly is 22.61 €/mo. A free Basic plan is offered.

howToUse.title: Open Knowt
howToUse.description: Open Knowt and choose Continue on the Website, or download the app.

howToUse.title: Study flashcards and record a lecture
howToUse.description: Create flashcards and study them in learn mode. Record a lecture and let Knowt turn that recording into notes and tests through summarisation.

howToUse.title: Use voice tutoring and AP preparation
howToUse.description: Use voice tutoring so you are quizzed on your materials, and open the AP exam preparation for practice and mock exams.

howToUse.title: Start on Basic or try Ultra
howToUse.description: Begin on Basic, which costs nothing and allows unlimited file creation. Move to Ultra or Max when you need higher limits.

features: AI study platform with flashcards, lecture summaries, practice tests and AP exam prep.
Knowt offers AI study tools: flashcards with learn mode, lecture recording and summarisation into notes and tests, voice tutoring, and AP exam preparation.
It positions itself as a free alternative to Quizlet.
The Basic plan is free with unlimited file creation; Ultra and Max are paid tiers.
features_fr: Plateforme d'étude sur l'IA avec des flashcards, des résumés de cours, des tests pratiques et une préparation aux examens AP.
Knowt propose des outils d'étude en IA : cartes mémoire avec mode d'apprentissage, enregistrement de cours et résumé en notes et tests, tutorat vocal et préparation aux examens AP.
Il se positionne comme une alternative gratuite à Quizlet.
Le forfait Basic est gratuit avec une création de fichiers illimitée ; Ultra et Max sont des forfaits payants.
